consumer: The interactive pickup selection path (the engine's pickup menu / inventory_selector answered through the real active input loop) asking 'which of the ground-pile items did the player choose to pick up?'
scope: The interactive item-selection menu over the reachable ground pile, answered through the real input loop, so the chosen subset is produced by the engine's own pickup mechanism (not a raw item list).
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities (items) — it enumerates each nearby tile's raw map::i_at() ground stack and serializes type_id/name/symbol/charges into snapshot JSON; a read-only state dump that performs no selection.
divergence: A tile whose pile contains items the real pickup menu would group, filter, or refuse to offer (e.g. a corpse with nested contents or a non-pickable item): the raw i_at dump lists entries the interactive selector never presents, so a 'choice' read off the export selects items the engine's own pickup loop would never let the player take.
